Essen ( German pronunciation: [ˈɛsn̩] ⓘ ) is the central and, after Dortmund , second-largest city of the Ruhr , the largest urban area in Germany. Its population of 574,682 makes it the fourth-largest city of North Rhine-Westphalia after Cologne , Düsseldorf and Dortmund, as well as the tenth-largest city of Germany. Essen lies in the larger Rhine-Ruhr metropolitan region , second largest by GDP in the EU , and is part of the cultural area of Rhineland . Due to its central location in the Ruhr, Essen is often regarded as the Ruhr's "secret capital". [ 3 ]
